bio: The focus of the cuisine is aroma above all. Dishes are built around vegetables, with parts such as leaves, stalks and peels transformed through a variety of cooking methods. Presentation is modern, a layering of flavours and textures. The restaurant’s approach of ‘All Sustainable French’, using everything, wasting nothing, is its way of discovering new facets of familiar ingredients. Recycled materials in the décor reflect the same conviction....
